questions.q: After a load, which relationship should hold between source rows and Data Loader results?
options: Success rows always equal source rows
Error rows should always be zero
Source rows equal successful rows plus error rows
Source rows should equal the number of fields loaded
questions.explain: Every row you send ends up in either the success file or the error file, so the two together must account for the whole source.

questions.q: Why compare SUM(Amount) by stage in addition to record counts?
options: Matching totals catch problems, such as wrong amounts or stages, that matching row counts can hide
SUM is required by SOQL for every query
Row counts cannot be produced with SOQL
Amounts are not stored on Opportunity records
questions.explain: Two datasets can have the same row count but different values; comparing aggregates verifies content.

questions.q: Which query finds Contacts whose parent Account link did not resolve?
options: SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name = null
SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM Opportunity
SELECT Id FROM Contact GROUP BY Id
SELECT Id, LastName FROM Contact WHERE AccountId = null
questions.explain: Contacts with a null AccountId have no parent Account, which is worth investigating if the source says each should have one.

questions.q: Which query finds Accounts that have no Contacts?
options: SELECT Id FROM Contact WHERE AccountId != null
SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Id NOT IN (SELECT AccountId FROM Contact)
SELECT COUNT() FROM Account
SELECT Name FROM Account ORDER BY Name
questions.explain: A NOT IN subquery on Contact.AccountId returns Accounts without any Contacts.

questions.q: Why is a spot check by a person still needed after passing count checks?
options: Counts cannot be run in Salesforce
Spot checks replace the need for a sandbox
Counts cannot reveal truncated text, wrong dates, or incorrectly translated picklist values in individual records
Salesforce automatically corrects all errors that spot checks would find
questions.explain: Field-level errors can leave every count correct, so a comparison of real records against the source is a necessary layer.
